ImageDescription.value: Sarajevo after the big fire of 1879. "A series of five photographs that Ignaz Funk took in the aftermath of the devastating event provides a glimpse of the affected city fragment. Capturing the collapse of urban space, the photographs were addressed to Emperor Franz Joseph and sent on August 12, 1879, and most likely were not intended for broader audiences." (Aida Murtić, p.242)
